decisions.reason: Selecting Arden's content as the permitted source does not necessarily restore or change the previously removed strong-moment selection standard.
The permitted source collection does not establish or restore a hook-quality criterion, and message 21 does not explicitly require good hooks.

The batch quantity and delivery obligation are separately and completely represented by the candidate's existing message-21 MODIFY and RESUME Events; the source-selection change requires no additional candidate update.
Changing the permitted source to Arden's content does not necessarily resume or modify the deferred clean visual-editing requirement.
